# IvritSuite

> Free Hebrew worksheets, flash cards, dictionary, weekly parsha reader, and classroom tools for Hebrew learning and reading practice — for teachers and students.

Everything runs entirely in the browser. There are no accounts, no ads, and no server:
presets, settings and custom fonts are saved on your own device, and are backed up by
downloading a portable `.ivrit` save file. The whole suite installs as an offline PWA.
The interface is available in English and Hebrew. Content is CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (material
incorporating PocketTorah audio is CC BY-SA 4.0).

## Tools

- [Hebrew Worksheet Generator](https://ivritsuite.com/hebrew_blend_generator.html): Create printable Hebrew decoding worksheets, bingo cards, and vocabulary drills with nikkud.
- [Hebrew Word Lookup](https://ivritsuite.com/hebrew_dictionary.html): Browse and filter Hebrew vocabulary by theme, length, part of speech, era, and letter position.
- [Hebrew Classroom Dashboard](https://ivritsuite.com/classroom_dashboard.html): Live Hebrew date, time, weather, and days of the week for SmartBoard or projector display.
- [Hebrew Flash Cards](https://ivritsuite.com/flash_cards.html): Decode one, two, or three Hebrew letters at a time with full nikkud support.
- [Torah Trainer](https://ivritsuite.com/torah_trainer.html): Read the weekly parsha with vowel coloring, transliteration, translation, and chanted-audio karaoke.
- [Trope Tutor](https://ivritsuite.com/trope_tutor.html): Learn the Torah cantillation marks — symbols, Ashkenazi and Sephardi names, and melodies — with real chanted examples and three drill modes.
- [Hebrew Font Maker](https://ivritsuite.com/Hebrew_Font_Maker.html): Turn handwritten Hebrew letters into a real, installable font with nikkud and cantillation; export TTF, WOFF2, or UFO.
- [Hebrew Teaching Resources](https://ivritsuite.com/resources.html): A curated directory of free Hebrew learning resources, printables, and Jewish education tools.
